Class LocalFileRepository

java.lang.Object
project_biu.repository.LocalFileRepository
All Implemented Interfaces:
FileRepository
public class LocalFileRepository extends Object implements FileRepository
Stores files inside a single application-owned directory. The directory is created on construction and is the sole location used for managing files.
